summary: BidVex Sticky Card + Escrow + Legal Pages - All features tested and working. Backend: 14/14 tests passed. Frontend: All 3 legal pages verified with required content in EN/FR.
critical_code_review_comments: Escrow service properly implements 6-char pickup code generation with collision-safe alphabet
Sticky Card guard correctly blocks listing creation without payment method (402) and card deletion with active listings (409)
48-hour auto-release job registered in email_automation.py (runs every 15 minutes)
6 escrow indexes properly defined in lifecycle.py for performance
seed_data_creation: Test created 1 listing via admin account (auto-cleaned by auction end date)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Escrow system has no active escrows (no completed auctions with payments). Sticky Card guard is working - admin has payment method on file. Legal pages (ToS, Privacy, Policies) all load correctly in EN/FR with Sticky Card, Escrow, and Pickup Code sections.

POST /api/escrow/seller/confirm-pickup.details: Returns 400 for missing fields, 404 for non-existent escrow

GET /api/escrow/buyer/status.details: Returns list of escrows for authenticated user

GET /api/escrow/seller/status.details: Returns list of escrows for authenticated seller

POST /api/escrow/dispute.details: Returns 400 if auction_id or reason missing

POST /api/escrow/admin/charge-penalty.details: Returns 401/403 without auth, admin can access (422 for non-existent seller)

DELETE /api/payments/payment-methods/{id.details: Returns 409 with active listings (Sticky Card guard working)

POST /api/listings.details: Returns 402 without payment method, 200 with payment method

terms_of_service_page.details: Contains Sticky Card, Escrow, Pickup Code sections in EN/FR

privacy_policy_page.details: Contains Escrow data, Stripe customer data, Pickup Code Data sections

platform_policies_page.details: Contains Seller, Buyer, Partner, Community Q&A policies with data-testid

escrow_indexes.details: 6 indexes defined in lifecycle.py: auction_id (unique), pickup_code, escrow_status, auto_release_scheduled_at, buyer_id, seller_id
